full_name: Elaine Chew | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Mathematics Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow University of Southern California
bio: As a computational scientist, Elaine Chew designs mathematical models and computational techniques to analyze music and its performance; as a pianist, she performs widely as a proponent of contemporary eclectic repertoire.
